sources.description: On the 587th Sporticast episode, hosts Scott Soshnick and Eben Novy-Williams discuss some of the biggest sports business stories of the week, including the start of the 2026 NFL season. In 2010, NFL commissioner Roger Goodell set a goal of $25 million in revenue by 2027. The league will eclipse that total this year. So …
